text: The CBC shows mild anemia and your TSH is elevated with a normal Free T4, suggesting subclinical or early overt hypothyroidism. text: I haven't really noticed any of those specific symptoms like cold sensitivity or hair loss, though I do feel much colder than usual lately. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hypothyroidism with a confirmed co-infection of Typhoid fever.
